verdict.rationale: Lago supports event-driven automation via webhooks (triggered on invoice/payment events, with retries) and automatic invoice generation from usage events, plus an agentic Dunning Agent that reads account state and acts on overdue invoices — all forms of events triggering actions. However there is no documented user-facing rules engine where an AI-native user can define arbitrary conditional logic ('if event X then action Y') beyond fixed billing/webhook/dunning behaviors. Missing for 10: a configurable rule/trigger builder, custom conditional logic beyond built-in dunning/webhook flows, and independent evidence of this automation working end-to-end.
